insights.one_liner: Source of five English-language internships in The Hague, Petten and Amsterdam; the dossier says little about the employer itself.

culture.text: Lists 5 internships across research, legal, healthcare and data, in The Hague (3), Petten and Amsterdam.
One posting is from Women2Invest, which trains women with STEAM backgrounds for venture-capital careers through paid fund internships.

open.text: All 5 internships are open to non-Dutch speakers.
Not found as an IND recognised sponsor.
